summary: Six-digit one-time-code field backed by one real input, so typing, paste and code autofill work; a wrong code shakes and falls away.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled digits entered so far. Use with `onValueChange`.

props.name: code
props.description: Expected code. When set, a complete entry is compared with it; when missing, any six digits are valid.

props.name: hint
props.description: Message under the boxes until a code is checked, and again after `reset()`.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the digits submit under it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the boxes and disables the input.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the digits entered so far on every change.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called when the sixth digit is entered, with the code and whether it matched `code`.

methods.description: Clears the digits and the result, cancels the pending clear after a wrong code, and shows the hint again.
Moves focus into the code input.

keyboard.action: Ignored, so the caret stays at the end of the code.

accessibility: One native `<input>` with `inputmode="numeric"`, `autocomplete="one-time-code"` and `aria-label="6-digit code"` covers the boxes. The boxes are drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas and the digits in them are `aria-hidden` text, so assistive technology reads the input's value.
The message line describes the input (`aria-describedby`) and is an `aria-live="polite"` region, so "Code verified" and the mismatch message are announced.
After a wrong code the field clears and keeps focus (it is focused again if focus fell to the page, never taken from another control); after a correct code the input loses focus.
motion: With reduced motion digits appear in place without rising, and the success sparks and error shake are skipped; removed digits still break into pixels.
form: A native `<input>` submits the digits entered so far under `name`. It never reports itself invalid; after a wrong code the value is cleared 650 ms later. Form reset works like `reset()`.
notes: The comparison with `code` runs in the browser, so the expected code is visible to anyone who looks; treat it as a demo aid and verify codes on the server.
Digits are text in the mono font with tabular figures. They rise into their boxes; a removed digit breaks into pixels sampled from its glyph, and a rejected code falls away as red pixels.
After a correct code, further typing is ignored until `reset()` is called.
Non-digits are stripped and input stops at six digits, so a pasted or autofilled "424 242" completes. Messages are in English.
The root carries `data-state="ok"` or `data-state="error"` while a result shows.
